`domain:cli` · `bug` · `pm:queue` · `priority:p2`。落点 `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` ⇒ 车道表把 `runtime` 归 **cli** 车道。

## ⭐ 那处不对称本席逐行验过了,它确实存在

```
app-plugin.ts:1156-1157   if (manifest && Array.isArray(manifest.data)) { seedDatasets.push(...manifest.data); }      ← 无引用守卫
app-plugin.ts:1745        if (manifest && Array.isArray(manifest.translations) && manifest.translations !== this.collections.translations) {   ← 有守卫
```
⇒ **同一个方法里的两个「两处读取」收集器,一个带引用检查,一个不带**。你说「那个不对称就是整个 bug」——实测支持这句话。

**p2 判据**:⛔ 不是 p3(不是「多做一遍功」那么轻):对 **`mode: 'insert'`** 的数据集,一次启动会**应用两遍**,而 `mergeSeedDatasets` 是纯 `push`、**不去重** ⇒ 与已关的 #3434 是同一个终态(showcase 成员 3 → 6 → 9),只是经由另一条路到达 —— 那张卡修的是「重复启动」,修不到「一次启动收集两遍」。⛔ 不是 p1:触发形状是**扁平 bundle + 顶层 `data`**,而本席**未测量**任何已发布示例应用是否用这个形状(你举的是本仓自己的测试 `app-plugin.jobs.test.ts`)。⇒ 可达但总体未知。⭐ **提级条件**:若测到任一 shipped 应用用扁平 bundle 带顶层 `data`,重估 p1。

⭐ 你给的验证形状本席原样转达:回归测试要一个**没有 `manifest` 键**、带顶层 `data` 的 bundle,断言到达 `readSeedDatasets(ctx)` 的数据集数是 **1 而不是 2**;现成台架是 `app-plugin.seed.test.ts` 与 `app-plugin.disabled-seed.test.ts`。⚠️ 你提的「顺带检查 `start()` 里还有没有别的两处读取缺守卫」值得写进派发词 —— 已经确认有两个这样的收集器,**第三个存在与否没人测过**。

**CLAIM** — `domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024), R69.

- Session: `session_01D47qPfEWVPmhguWgBZCi5N`
- Branch: `claude/issue-15262-app-plugin-seed-dataset-double-collect`
- Tier: **`opus`**. **Clause ②: `no`** — an internal collector gains the reference guard its sibling already has; no published surface, no wire contract, and the behaviour change is a **repair toward the intended one** (the same shape triage used to keep #14858 out of the decision inbox). ⚠️ Re-declared from the delivered diff at report time.

## Premise re-verified on `origin/main` — the asymmetry is real, byte for byte

⛔ Not read through the card or through triage. Probes run **unpiped** with exit codes captured and a positive control (`seedDatasets`, 6 hits in the same file):

```
app-plugin.ts:1156   if (manifest && Array.isArray(manifest.data)) {
app-plugin.ts:1157       seedDatasets.push(...manifest.data);            ← ⛔ NO reference guard

app-plugin.ts:1745   if (manifest && Array.isArray(manifest.translations)
                         && manifest.translations !== this.collections.translations) {   ← ✅ guard
```

⇒ **Two two-location collectors in one method; one carries the reference check and the other does not.** The card's claim that *"that asymmetry is the whole bug"* survives being read at source.

## ⭐ Triage's open item, narrowed by one measurement here

Triage carried the card's *"worth checking in the same pass whether any other two-location read in `start()` is missing it"* and recorded that ⚠️ **nobody had measured whether a third exists**. Narrowed, ⛔ not closed:

**`Array.isArray(manifest.` matches exactly TWO sites in the whole file — `:1156` and `:1745`.** ⇒ On **that spelling** there is no third.

⛔ That is one spelling, not a census. A two-location read could be written `manifest?.data`, could test a non-array collection, or could merge rather than push. ⇒ **The third's existence is still open on other spellings**, and the flight owes a real enumeration rather than a repeat of this grep.

## ⚠️ Triage's upgrade condition is carried as a live duty, not a footnote

> ⭐ **提级条件**:若测到任一 shipped 应用用扁平 bundle 带顶层 `data`,重估 p1。

Triage graded `p2` explicitly because the trigger shape — a **flat bundle with a top-level `data` array** — was demonstrated only by this repo's **own test** (`app-plugin.jobs.test.ts`), and ⛔ **no shipped application was measured**. ⇒ If the flight measures a shipped app in that shape, **stop and report**: the grading changes, and re-grading is triage's, not the lane's.

## Serial — CLEAR, measured

All 29 open PR heads fetched **per-ref** at `--depth=80`, merge-base computed on every row: **29/29 MEASURED, 0 hits** on `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`. No `NO MERGE-BASE`, no fetch failures.

⚠️ Named because it is adjacent and this seat has been wrong about adjacency before: **#15068 is in flight on `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`** — **same package, different file.** Seat ruling ①: same-package is **EXEMPT**, same-file is hard serial. ⇒ not a conflict, and the dev is fenced off that file explicitly.

Dispatching now.

**ACCEPT** — PR #15605. Reviewed against the delivered diff. Three files, **+158/−1**; the code change is **one line**.

## The guard mirrors its sibling byte for byte — verified, not accepted on report

```
repaired  :1165  if (manifest && Array.isArray(manifest.data)         && manifest.data         !== this.collections.data)         {
sibling   :1758  if (manifest && Array.isArray(manifest.translations) && manifest.translations !== this.collections.translations) {
```

⭐ Same form, same operand order, same position in the condition. ⛔ Not a third spelling of the same idea — which was the one way to "fix" this card and leave a new asymmetry behind.

**Clause ② re-declared from the delivered diff: `no`.** One reference check on an internal collector; no published surface, no wire contract, and the behaviour change is a repair toward the intended one.

## ⭐ The anti-vacuity pin is the one that makes this a fix rather than a deletion

Three pins were added to the rig the card names. The third is the one worth calling out: **a genuinely distinct `manifest.data` still contributes both sources.**

⇒ That is the control a *"just delete the legacy fallback"* fix would **fail**. It pins that the fallback still does its job when the two locations really are two, which is the whole reason the guard is the right shape and deletion is not. ⭐ And it stayed **green through the ablation**, while the two behavioural pins went red exactly as predicted.

## ⭐⭐ Both of my "not measured by me" items were closed, one by driving it

- `mergeSeedDatasets` is a plain `push` with no de-duplication by reference, identity or content — **confirmed at source**. ⇒ the card's "not harmless" argument stands on a verified foundation.
- `mode: 'insert'` applied twice — ⭐ **confirmed by DRIVING it, not by reasoning from the absence of de-duplication**: `ql.insert` called **2** times for one record before, **1** after. ⇒ **doubled ROWS, not doubled work.** That is the difference between the `p3` this could have been and the `p2` triage graded.

## ⭐⭐ Triage's upgrade condition: MEASURED and NOT MET — with an instrument and a control

Triage graded `p2` explicitly on an unknown, and set the escalation trigger. It is now a reading:

> **0 shipped apps construct a flat bundle with a top-level `data` array.**

⭐ And the method is why I accept the zero: the **TypeScript compiler API** over every `defineStack(...)` / `composeStacks(...)` call — 128 candidate files, 19 real object literals — with a **positive control run FIRST** (a synthetic `{ id, name, data: [...] }` was flagged FLAT+DATA, so the instrument demonstrably sees the shape). All five shipped stacks declare `manifest: { … }`; the three carrying seed `data` all nest it. ⇒ **none was ever double-collecting.**

⛔ And it handed the conclusion over correctly: *"Re-grading is triage's either way — this is a reading handed over, not a re-grade."* **`p2` stands.**

## ⭐⭐ The collector census: SIX members, and a third collector DOES exist — but none needs repair

I narrowed this by one grep and said plainly that one spelling is not a census. The flight did the census properly, by **intersecting two independently derived enumerations** rather than repeating mine — every accumulator in the file, and every read off a manifest-fallback alias — ⭐ **with a positive control: the histogram surfaced `manifest.data` and `manifest.translations` before either was looked for.**

Six members, and each non-member is safe for a **named, different** reason:

| | why it is safe |
|:--|:--|
| `data` (start) | ⛔ **was unguarded — this PR** |
| `translations` (`loadTranslations`) | reference guard, pre-existing |
| `collectBundleHooks` | per-item `seen` Set **and** no `|| bundle` fallback ⇒ a flat bundle never re-reads it — safe twice over |
| `collectBundleActions` | same shape plus the `objects[*].actions` sources, same `seen` Set |
| `collectBundleFunctionEntries` | merges into a keyed record (`out[name] = fn`) ⇒ idempotent by construction |
| the security bundle | an object spread with key-level override, ⛔ not accumulation |

⇒ **The answer to "is there a third?" is yes, three — and no widening is owed.** That is a much better result than either "no third" or a speculative sweep.

⚠️ And one sharp ruled-out row worth keeping: `jobs` is an either/or ternary, but it spells the legacy location `|| {}` rather than `|| this.bundle` — **a third spelling of "the legacy location" in this one file**. Harmless here; ⛔ named so nobody reads the file as having two conventions when it has three.

## ⚠️ My own claim, falsified

I wrote *"two two-location collectors in ONE method"*. **False.** The `data` collector is in `start()` (an arrow-function property at `:536`); `translations` is in the separate private `loadTranslations()` (`:1729`), which `start()` awaits. The card's *"~590 lines further down in the same method"* is wrong on the method and right on everything else — the two-location read, the guard and the asymmetry all read at source byte for byte. ⭐ Cosmetic, and correctly reported anyway.

## The discipline

**Resolution path stated and DEMONSTRATED**, not assumed: the suite imports `AppPlugin` relatively and `packages/runtime/vitest.config.ts` aliases every named `@objectstack/*` dep to its `src/`, so source resolution holds — ⭐ and the ablation proves it, since an **unrebuilt** source mutation moved the result. ⇒ `ablation-dist-preflight` correctly not invoked, and correctly not claimed.

Ablation direction predicted first; mutation proven on disk in **both** directions (guard text 1→0, marker 0→1, blob moved); restore proven by blob-hash equality with the HEAD blob, an empty `git diff HEAD`, marker back to 0 and guard text back to 1.

⭐ **And the typecheck's second leg is the one that mattered, for a reason the dev named**: `packages/runtime/tsconfig.json` excludes `**/*.test.ts`, so `tsc --noEmit` alone would have said **nothing** about the edited test file — `check:test-typecheck` is what compiled it. ⇒ the "typecheck is green" claim is measured to cover the file this PR adds, not assumed to.

Downstream readers of the shared `seed-datasets` registry **enumerated by grep rather than assumed** (`cloud-connection` seed-replayer, `cli` option-b reader acceptance) and run. 54/54 gate families green on a non-stale tree; two exit-3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` read as **NOT MEASURED**, then green after a 71/71 build. `pnpm lint` whole-repo, ⛔ not narrowed.

## 📌 The observation it declined to file — I filed the half that outlives its instance, as #15607

> The rig's own `bundleWithUser()` is **already** the trigger shape (`{ id, data: [...] }`, no manifest key), so **the seed suite has been booting a double-collecting bundle all along**. It stayed green because `expect(insert).toHaveBeenCalledWith(...)` **does not count calls**.

⛔ Its judgment not to file *that instance* is right — it is not shipped code and the three new pins close it. ⭐ But the idiom's reach is not closed by this PR: **an assertion that cannot see a repeat, guarding a path whose whole contract is idempotence**, is the same "green that was never earned" shape as #15027, #15500 and #14356 — located in a test idiom rather than a gate, which is what makes it hard to see.

**#15607** carries it with the honest framing: ⛔ **one instance is measured, the population is not**, the first task is to size the class, and ⛔ **do not mass-convert** — most sites genuinely do not care about arity, and pinning a count nobody chose would replace one over-claim with another.

**Next:** #15605's CI. ⛔ Not flipped or armed until every check run settles, read from the check runs and never from the combined status.
